lines.zh: 我昂着头在落叶间踱步。
lines.en: I strut through the fallen leaves with my head high.

lines.zh: 肉垂一晃一晃，跟着我走。
lines.en: My wattle swings back and forth as I walk.

lines.zh: 我用爪子刨开松软的腐叶。
lines.en: I scratch the soft leaf litter open with my claws.
My tail fans out like half a folding fan.

lines.zh: 我沿着林间小路慢慢晃。
lines.en: I wander down the forest path at my own pace.

lines.zh: 翅膀太短，我只用它平衡。
lines.en: My wings are too short; I only use them for balance.

lines.zh: 我一步一啄，找散落的种子。
lines.en: I peck at every step, hunting for scattered seeds.

lines.zh: 树叶沙沙，我踩着走过去。
lines.en: The leaves rustle as I tramp straight across them.
I step around the roots so I do not trip.

lines.zh: 脖子一伸一缩，我在赶路。
lines.en: My neck stretches and shrinks as I hurry along.

lines.zh: 我踩过苔藓，脚底有点滑。
lines.en: I cross the moss and my feet slip a little.

lines.zh: 走进阴影里，羽毛都炸开。
lines.en: Entering the shade, my feathers puff right up.
I flap twice and hop over the little ditch.

lines.zh: 森林这么大，我慢慢巡逻。
lines.en: The forest is vast; I patrol it slowly.

lines.zh: 我停下来侧头，听落叶底下有没有虫。
lines.en: I stop and tilt my head for bugs under the leaves.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，抖落一层薄霜。
lines.en: I shake my wings and a thin frost falls off.

lines.zh: 我站着，喉咙里咕噜作响。
lines.en: I stand still and rumble deep in my throat.

lines.zh: 阳光正好，我理了理胸羽。
lines.en: The sun is good, so I preen my breast feathers.
I tilt my head toward distant insect song.
The wind blows and I shake myself out.
I stare at the ground, hoping for a worm.

lines.zh: 这棵树下虫子应该不少。
lines.en: There should be plenty of bugs under this tree.

lines.zh: 我咕咕叫了两声，没人答。
lines.en: I gobble twice and nobody answers me.

lines.zh: 我在树影里眯起了眼睛。
lines.en: I narrow my eyes in the shade of the tree.

lines.zh: 今天不用逃，也没人追我。
lines.en: No need to flee today; nobody chases me.

lines.zh: 我把喙埋进翅膀里磨蹭。
lines.en: I tuck my beak into my wing and rub it.

lines.zh: 落叶堆很软，我蹲一会儿。
lines.en: The leaf pile is soft, so I squat a while.

lines.zh: 我数着树上的光斑发呆。
lines.en: I count the light spots on the bark and drift off.
I raise my head and watch your hands.
Have you come looking for feathers?
I turn sideways so you can see me clearly.
Do not come too close; I bite.
You smell faintly of grain.
I size you up as if weighing you.
I tilt my head and fix one eye on you.

lines.zh: 我咕咕地站着，看你要做什么。
lines.en: I stand here gobbling, watching what you do.

lines.zh: 我低头，又偷偷抬眼看你。
lines.en: I look down, then peek up at you again.
Hello there, two-legged creature of the forest.
Ouch! My feathers are all messed up.
That blow sends me stumbling.
My wing gives out and I nearly fall.
Blood on the leaves stands out badly.
I gasp for air, my throat tight.
Whoever did that, I will never forget.
I retreat behind a tree to hide.
The pain keeps coming in waves.

lines.zh: 胸前的羽毛乱了，我照样站着。
lines.en: My breast feathers are a mess and I'm still standing.
Three feathers gone; I'll remember this.
Wheat seeds? I am coming right over.

lines.zh: 你手心里那点东西真香。
lines.en: Whatever is in your palm smells wonderful.
Beetroot seeds work too; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 南瓜子晃得我眼都直了。
lines.en: Those pumpkin seeds make my eyes go wide.

lines.zh: 我小跑过去，脖子伸得老长。
lines.en: I trot over with my neck stretched out long.

lines.zh: 那颗下界疣你从哪弄来的？
lines.en: Where did you get that nether wart?
Melon seeds all over the ground? Mine, all of it.
I circle you, waiting for your hand to open.

lines.zh: 别逗我，我喙已经张开了。
lines.en: Stop teasing me; my beak is already open.

lines.zh: 为了种子，我什么都肯干。
lines.en: For seeds I would do almost anything.
Hey, you stepped on my foot.

lines.zh: 我撞上你的腿，弹了回去。
lines.en: I bump into your leg and bounce backward.
Do not shove; my bones are light.

lines.zh: 我扑腾着从你脚边让开。
lines.en: I flap my way clear of your boots.
Two feathers fell out; you owe me for those.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我转了个圈。
lines.en: We collide and I spin around in a circle.
You are in the way, so I will go around.
I back off two steps, then puff out my chest.

lines.zh: 撞得我咕了一声，很狼狈。
lines.en: The bump knocks a gobble out of me.

lines.zh: 下次走路看着点，两脚兽。
lines.en: Watch where you walk next time, two-legs.

lines.zh: 给我两颗种子，我就考虑。
lines.en: Give me two seeds and I will consider it.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经张到最大。
lines.en: My tail is fanned as wide as it will go.

lines.zh: 她看了我一眼，我腿都软了。
lines.en: She glances at me and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 我在她面前转圈，展示羽毛。
lines.en: I circle before her, showing off my feathers.

lines.zh: 下界疣也能换一次心意。
lines.en: Even nether wart can buy a little affection.

lines.zh: 我们配对，但别指望有蛋。
lines.en: We pair up, but do not expect any eggs.

lines.zh: 我的肉垂越红，越有面子。
lines.en: The redder my wattle, the more respect I get.

lines.zh: 她啄了我一下，算是答应。
lines.en: She pecks me once, which counts as a yes.

lines.zh: 种子吃完，我们就各走各的。
lines.en: Once the seeds are gone, we go our own ways.

lines.zh: 我这辈子一颗蛋都不下。
lines.en: Not one egg will I lay in my whole life.
A seed on the ground? That one is mine.
I pick it up, then drop it again.
Is this edible? Let me give it a try.
I hide it underneath the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 喙太小，夹不住这么大的。
lines.en: My beak is too small to hold something this big.
One dip of my head and it is gone.

lines.zh: 谁丢的？反正现在是我的。
lines.en: Who dropped this? It is mine now anyway.

lines.zh: 我把它甩两下，看看动静。
lines.en: I shake it twice to see what it does.
It glitters, and it is no seed.
I carry it in my beak, afraid of thieves.
Who hit me? I will remember you.
I fan my tail feathers and charge.

lines.zh: 森林里的鸟也不都怕事。
lines.en: Not every forest bird runs from a fight.
Touch me and I will peck you.

lines.zh: 我咯咯叫着扑向你的脚踝。
lines.en: Clucking, I lunge at your ankles.
Six hearts or not, I will not back down.
Step back and I can still chase you.

lines.zh: 我扑下去，只啄你的脚踝。
lines.en: I'll dive and peck only your ankles.
I have marked this grudge, two-legs.
Do not think running away is all I can do.
I circle you, looking for a gap.
When you move, I turn with you.
My claws are already drawn tight.
Raise your hand and I hop backward.

lines.zh: 我在等一个能啄到的角度。
lines.en: I am waiting for an angle I can peck.
You are breathing hard; so am I.
This fight is a poor bargain for me.
Just half a step closer is all I need.
Your boots look rather hard.
I pretend to flee, but really I am circling.
I peck you right on the knee!
My wings slap down with a loud crack.

lines.zh: 就一点伤害，但也是伤害。
lines.en: Only one point of damage, but damage still.
I leap up and slam into you.
My claws rake across you, leaving a shallow line.
I put everything I have into that blow.
You flinch, so I have won half a round.
Never underestimate a turkey's beak.
I strike once and retreat, no greed.
Gobble, gobble, I am still fighting!
I push up out of the leaf litter.
This grove falls under my patrol now.
The shade shifts and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 又是新的一天，先找种子。
lines.en: A new day; seeds come first.
I shake the dead leaves off my back.
Who is moving through this forest?
I just woke up and my voice is hoarse.

lines.zh: 阳光穿过树冠落在我身上。
lines.en: Sunlight comes through the canopy onto me.

lines.zh: 我叫一声，让林子知道我来了。
lines.en: I call out so the woods know I am here.
My feathers are still messy, so I will stand a while.
The flame singes my feathers and the stench is sharp.

lines.zh: 从树上摔下来，骨头都震了。
lines.en: Falling from the tree rattles every bone in me.

lines.zh: 水灌进喙里，我拼命扑腾。
lines.en: Water fills my beak and I thrash wildly.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀飞了我一身羽毛。
lines.en: The blast blew off half my feathers.

lines.zh: 箭擦过翅膀，划出一道口子。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my wing and opens a cut.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光缠住我，我动不了。
lines.en: Strange light binds me and I cannot move.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我连啄的力气都没。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I barely have the strength to peck.

lines.zh: 雷劈在附近，我全身羽毛立起。
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and every feather stands up.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我一直往下掉。
lines.en: Nothing beneath me; I just keep falling down.
